thread:
maya: Heads up — Rivermart reporting repeated p99+ spikes on their Dedicated pool, SLAs starting to flag. Can we get quick owners and a short-term workaround? Ticket #6712 linked.
ken: I can own coordinating with support + infra. @samir please take initial triage on the runtime side.
samir: On it. Pulling tail logs now, will post findings in ~15.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-6712 (Rivermart dedicated latency). Pager duty escalated to eng-oncall.
elaine: If it's model/KV cache related we can flip them to the lower-latency quantized variant as fallback. Small config change, no deploy.
alex_m: pinging for quick CR reviews — if Samir opens a hotfix PR I'll take a look within 30m.
samir: Found a KV-cache miss storm correlated with long prefix lengths. Repro in bench. Proposing temporary cache-control tweak and a rollout to the affected pool only.
samir: Suggested command for pool config patch (canary first):
```
redwoodctl routing set --pool rivermart-dedicated --kv-cache-mode relaxed --canary 10%
```
ken: Sounds good. @elaine can you prepare the routing fallback config in parallel? I'll notify Rivermart support and request they route lower-LRU workloads to the fallback pool.
elaine: Yep, preparing config now and will paste it here. small snippet: `variant_route: quantized-v2 -> weight 100 if pool==rivermart-dedicated and latency>500ms`
alex_m: Samir — PR pls. I'll prioritize the review. If we need an emergency commit, I'll approve and merge once CI passes smoke tests.
samir: PR: https://git.redwood/s/rivermart/patches/382 (hotfix/kv-cache-relax). Includes canary flag + rollback.
ken: I'll coordinate the canary rollout after PR merged. ETA: merge+canary start in ~45m. Coordinating with support to mark this P1.
maya: Thanks team. Quick ask — confirm EOD: 1) canary started, 2) initial latency drop observed, 3) rollback plan ready. Reply with short status when done.
alex_m: Will update here after review (30m).
samir: Will post metrics snapshot once canary is at 10%.
ken: Noted — I'll keep customer comms in the ticket.
maya: Appreciate it. If anything blocks review ping me directly. :thumbsup:
